Name: Rescue: Field Triage at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Settlement Contract. Treat the wounded settlers at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>. Bring three med packs. Payment on contract completion.

LogEntries.Entry: Raiders hit the <Alias=TargetLocation> and left three of its people wounded. The settlement needs someone with med packs.
I closed a deep cut on a settler's arm. Next, the one with burnt hands.
I dressed a settler's burnt hands. Next, the one who took a knock to the head.
Raiders left three people wounded at the <Alias=TargetLocation>. I treated all three, worst first.

Objectives.DisplayText: Treat the bleeding settler at the <Alias=TargetLocation>
Treat the settler with burnt hands
Treat the settler who took a knock to the head

Lines.ResponseText: It's my arm. I've been holding it shut since they left, and my hand's gone numb from doing it.
[Give Med Pack] Let go of it. I've got a med pack.
That stings worse than the cut did. Go on, see to the others. I'll keep.
They came in shooting, took what they could carry, and left us where we fell.
Over here. I'm the one bleeding.
[Give Med Pack] Hold them out. This will cool them.
They set the store going. I went in.
Did you save any of it?
Someone hit me with something. Or I hit something. What day is it? Don't tell me, I'll get it.
[Give Med Pack] Sit still and look at me. Med pack.
Oh, that's better, the ground's stopped moving. It's Tuesday. Is it Tuesday? I'm going with Tuesday.
How many fingers am I holding up?
Four. Five? You keep moving them about.
They hit us at first light. Three of ours are down. Start with the one who's bleeding, then the hands. The lad who took the knock can wait, he's talking.
